description: Independently verify any FairSeal receipt (notarize nr_… or anchor anc_…) by fetching it from api.fairseal.io and running local cryptographic verification via @fairseal/verify. Returns a four-state verdict: verified (on-chain proof passes all checks), invalid (tampered or bad proof), unsupported (unrecognized schema or format), or indeterminate (receipt unreachable / chain offline / not yet anchored). Fail-closed: 'verified' is only returned when ALL checks pass. No API key required. AIs can verify, not just humans.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID to fetch and verify — starts with nr_ (notarize) or anc_ (anchor). Provide this OR receipt_json, not both.

receipt_json.description: Full receipt JSON object if you already have it. Provide this OR receipt_id, not both.

name: fairseal_verify_receipt
title: Verify a FairSeal receipt
